prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Create a FINISHED display advertisement supplied by an independent advertiser, not a photograph for a web page, not a website component or card. The finished raster includes its own complete brand identity, campaign typography, artwork, persuasive copy and a prominent call-to-action drawn into the advertisement. All requested Italian wording must be exact and highly legible. Professional real-world ad agency art direction. Use only the brief's copy; no fake prices, discounts, deadlines or added claims. No weather-site branding or shared weather palette. No outer frame or watermark. Make the entire canvas the single ad; no grid of options, no mockup screen.
Format: MEDIUM RECTANGLE 300×250, landscape ratio 6:5. Generate a compact rectangular canvas with this exact ratio.
Input image 1: Caffè TTC interior identity reference. Input image 2: product/lighting reference for the same café.
Creative concept: premium café ad with integrated cinematic product photography. Forest green #162e28, warm golden pastry and coffee tones, cream lettering. A beautifully lit large cappuccino and croissant occupy the right and lower part against the warm wooden café interior. The left is deep green with a small elegant espresso-cup emblem and brand at top, a large two-line inviting headline, and a cream translucent rounded pill CTA. Modern Inter-like sans, subtle liquid glass material only on the CTA. Entire artwork feels like an independent café campaign.
Text verbatim: brand "Caffè TTC"; headline "Un buon caffè. Un po’ di tempo."; CTA "Entra al TTC". No additional text. Prioritize large readable wording at a 300px display size. No navy/orange weather graphic.
